events.headline: Mavericks trade Luka Doncic to Lakers for Anthony Davis (3-team deal with Jazz)
events.detail: Reported by ESPN's Shams Charania late Sat Feb 1 / just after midnight ET Feb 2; ESPN story timestamp 12:21 AM ET Feb 2 (initial social post minutes earlier, exact minute unverified). LAL get Doncic, Kleber, Morris; DAL get Davis, Max Christie, LAL 2029 1st; UTA get Hood-Schifino + 2nds. Doncic had not requested a trade; first time two reigning All-NBA players swapped midseason.

events.headline: Kings trade De'Aaron Fox to Spurs in 3-team deal (Zach LaVine to Sacramento)
events.detail: Spurs announced the deal Monday Feb 3, 2025 (first reported the prior night; exact report time unverified). SAS get Fox + Jordan McLaughlin; SAC get LaVine, Sidy Cissoko, three 1sts, three 2nds; CHI get Zach Collins, Tre Jones, Kevin Huerter and their 2025 1st back.

events.headline: Heat trade Jimmy Butler to Warriors in five-team deal
events.detail: Reported Wed Feb 5, 2025 shortly before GSW-UTA tip (time = ESPN story timestamp). GSW send Wiggins, Kyle Anderson, top-10-protected 2025 1st to MIA; Schroder to UTA; Lindy Waters to DET. Butler opted out and agreed to 2-yr/$111M extension. Ended a ~2-month saga with three Heat suspensions.

events.headline: Anthony Davis strains left adductor in Mavericks debut
events.detail: Davis had 26 pts/16 reb in DAL's 116-105 win over HOU but left in the 3rd quarter; out multiple weeks (about six). Undercut the Davis side of the Doncic trade immediately.

events.headline: Luka Doncic makes Lakers debut vs. Jazz (first game since Christmas calf strain)
events.detail: 14 pts in ~24 min in a 132-113 win; first appearance since a Dec 25, 2024 calf strain.

events.headline: Victor Wembanyama ruled out for season with deep vein thrombosis (right shoulder)
events.detail: Diagnosed after All-Star weekend; Spurs said not career-threatening. Removed the Fox+Wembanyama pairing for the rest of 2024-25.

events.headline: Kyrie Irving tears left ACL vs. Kings; out for season
events.detail: Injury Mar 3; torn ACL announced Mar 4. Compounded post-Doncic-trade collapse; DAL later lost in play-in.

events.headline: Jalen Brunson sprains right ankle vs. Lakers; out at least 2 weeks
events.detail: Injured in OT of a 113-109 loss to LAL; returned in final two weeks of regular season.

events.headline: Nuggets fire coach Michael Malone and GM Calvin Booth with 3 games left
events.detail: Unprecedented late-season change; David Adelman named interim (hired full-time May 22, 2025). DEN were 47-32 on a 4-game skid.

events.headline: Thunder sweep Grizzlies 4-0 (1st round)
events.detail: Game 4 at Memphis, OKC 117-115.

events.headline: Damian Lillard tears left Achilles in Game 4 vs. Pacers
events.detail: Third game back from a right-calf DVT; MIL lost 129-103 to fall behind 3-1. Confirmed by MRI Apr 28. Rival-star shock for IND.

events.headline: No. 1 Cavaliers sweep Heat 4-0
events.detail: Game 4 at Miami, CLE 138-83.

events.headline: Pacers eliminate Bucks 4-1 in overtime Game 5
events.detail: IND 119-118 (OT) at home.

events.headline: Celtics eliminate Magic 4-1
events.detail: BOS 120-89 in Game 5.

events.headline: Timberwolves eliminate Doncic's Lakers 4-1 (1st round)
events.detail: MIN 103-96 at LAL in Game 5. Ends the first Doncic-Lakers playoff run within 3 months of the trade.

events.headline: Knicks eliminate Pistons 4-2
events.detail: NYK 116-113 in Game 6 at Detroit.

events.headline: Nuggets beat Clippers in Game 7
events.detail: DEN 120-101 at home.

events.headline: Warriors (7) beat No. 2 Rockets in Game 7
events.detail: GSW 103-89 at Houston.

events.headline: Stephen Curry strains left hamstring in Game 1 at Minnesota
events.detail: Grade 1 strain, left in 2nd quarter; GSW still won 99-88 but Curry missed the rest of the series (GSW lost 4-1).

events.headline: Jayson Tatum ruptures right Achilles late in Game 4 at MSG
events.detail: Injured with 2:58 left in Q4 (approx. 9:45-10:00 PM ET; tip 7:30 PM) of a 121-113 NYK win; NYK led series 3-1. Surgery May 13. Out most/all of 2025-26.

events.headline: Rival-star shock for Knicks: Tatum's Achilles rupture removes defending champs' best player
events.detail: Mirror record of the Tatum injury from the Knicks' perspective (NYK up 3-1). NYK closed the series 4 days later and reached first ECF since 2000.

events.headline: Mavericks win 2025 draft lottery with 1.8% odds (No. 1 pick -> Cooper Flagg)
events.detail: 4th-lowest odds to win since 1985; SAS 2nd, PHI 3rd, CHA 4th. Revived fan anger/'rigged' claims over the Doncic trade.

events.headline: Pacers eliminate No. 1 Cavaliers 4-1
events.detail: IND 114-105 at Cleveland in Game 5.

events.headline: Timberwolves eliminate Curry-less Warriors 4-1
events.detail: MIN 121-110 in Game 5.

events.headline: Knicks eliminate defending-champion Celtics 4-2; first ECF since 2000
events.detail: NYK 119-81 in Game 6 at MSG.

events.headline: Thunder beat Nuggets in Game 7
events.detail: OKC 125-93 at home.

events.headline: Thunder beat Timberwolves 4-1 to win West, reach first Finals since 2012
events.detail: OKC 124-94 in Game 5.

events.headline: Pacers eliminate Knicks 4-2 in ECF; reach first Finals since 2000
events.detail: IND 125-108 in Game 6 at Indianapolis.

events.headline: Knicks fire Tom Thibodeau days after ECF loss
events.detail: Dismissed after 5 seasons; Mike Brown hired July 7, 2025.

events.headline: Finals Game 1: Haliburton jumper with 0.3s left steals Game 1 in OKC
events.detail: IND 111-110; Pacers led for only 0.3 seconds.

events.headline: Finals Game 5: Thunder win 120-109 for 3-2 lead; Haliburton strains right calf
events.detail: Haliburton played Game 6 and 7 on the calf strain.

events.headline: Finals Game 6: Pacers rout Thunder 108-91 to force Game 7
events.detail: First Finals Game 7 since 2016.

events.headline: Suns trade Kevin Durant to Rockets (later a record 7-team trade)
events.detail: Reported the afternoon of Finals Game 7 (time = ESPN story timestamp). PHX get Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks, No. 10 pick, five 2nds; finalized July 6, 2025 as a 7-team, 13-player deal.

events.headline: Tyrese Haliburton tears right Achilles in 1st quarter of Finals Game 7
events.detail: Injured with 4:55 left in Q1 (approx. 8:20 PM ET); IND still led 48-47 at half before OKC pulled away.

events.headline: Rival-star shock for Thunder: Haliburton exits Game 7 with Achilles tear
events.detail: Mirror record of the Haliburton injury from OKC's perspective; an in-game probability shock just before the title was decided.

events.headline: Thunder win 2025 NBA championship, beat Pacers 103-91 in Game 7
events.detail: First title of the OKC era; Shai Gilgeous-Alexander Finals MVP (29 pts, 12 ast).

events.headline: Celtics trade Jrue Holiday to Trail Blazers for Anfernee Simons
events.detail: First of two Celtics salary-shedding deals in two days with Tatum out.

events.headline: Celtics trade Kristaps Porzingis to Hawks (3-team with Nets)
events.detail: BOS received Georges Niang + 2nd.

events.headline: Mavericks draft Cooper Flagg No. 1 overall
events.detail: 2025 NBA Draft at Barclays Center, June 25-26.

events.headline: Bucks waive and stretch Damian Lillard; Myles Turner leaves Pacers for Bucks (4 yr/$107M)
events.detail: Removes Turner from the reigning East champions days after Haliburton's Achilles tear.

events.headline: Pacers confirm Haliburton will miss entire 2025-26 season
events.detail: Kevin Pritchard: 'He will not play next year though.' (time = ESPN story timestamp). Effectively removed the 2025 East champion from the 2026 title race; rival-team beneficiaries NYK/CLE/DET/BOS.

events.headline: Knicks hire Mike Brown as head coach
Chauncey Billups and Terry Rozier arrested in federal gambling cases; both placed on leave
events.detail: Tiago Splitter named POR interim coach.

events.headline: Victor Wembanyama strains left calf vs. Warriors; misses 12 games
events.detail: Initial 2-3 week re-evaluation window; returned Dec 13 in NBA Cup semifinal.

events.headline: Wembanyama returns; Spurs beat Thunder in NBA Cup semifinal, ending OKC's 16-game win streak
events.detail: Played on a minutes limit after 12-game absence.

events.headline: Knicks beat Spurs 124-113 to win NBA Cup in Las Vegas; Brunson Cup MVP
events.detail: First Knicks trophy since 1973; preview of the 2026 Finals matchup.

events.headline: Clippers trade James Harden to Cavaliers for Darius Garland
events.detail: Reported Feb 3 (ESPN timestamp); announced Feb 4. CLE went 21-9 after Harden's debut.

events.headline: Mavericks trade Anthony Davis to Wizards in 9-player, 3-team deal
events.detail: Closes the Davis side of the Doncic trade one year later; DAL get Middleton and five picks (time = ESPN story timestamp).

events.headline: Jayson Tatum returns from Achilles rupture ~10 months later
events.detail: 15 pts/12 reb/7 ast in 120-100 win over DAL after missing first 62 games.

events.headline: Luka Doncic suffers Grade 2 left hamstring strain at OKC; misses rest of season and playoffs
events.detail: Missed final 15 games incl. entire postseason; LAL still beat HOU before being swept by OKC.

events.headline: Joel Embiid undergoes appendectomy; playoff status in doubt
events.detail: Returned Apr 26 (Game 4 vs BOS), 17 days post-surgery.

events.headline: Thunder sweep Suns 4-0
events.detail: OKC 131-122 in Game 4.

events.headline: Spurs eliminate Trail Blazers 4-1
events.detail: SAS 114-95 in Game 5.

events.headline: Knicks eliminate Hawks 4-2 with 140-89 rout
events.detail: NBA-record 47-point halftime lead; started a 13-game playoff win streak run (from Game 4).

events.headline: No. 3 Nuggets eliminated 4-2 by Timberwolves
events.detail: MIN 110-98 in Game 6.

events.headline: Doncic-less Lakers eliminate Rockets 4-2
events.detail: LAL 98-78 in Game 6 at Houston.

events.headline: No. 2 Celtics blow 3-1 lead, eliminated by 76ers in Game 7
events.detail: PHI 109-100 at Boston. Removed NYK's most likely 2nd-round opponent (rival-elimination shock for NYK).

events.headline: No. 1 Pistons rally from 3-1 down to beat Magic in Game 7
events.detail: DET 116-94; first series win since 2008.

events.headline: Cavaliers beat Raptors in Game 7
Knicks sweep 76ers 4-0 (East semis)
events.detail: NYK 144-114 in Game 4.

events.headline: Thunder sweep Lakers 4-0 (West semis)
events.detail: OKC 115-110 in Game 4.

events.headline: Spurs eliminate Timberwolves 4-2
events.detail: SAS 139-109 in Game 6.

events.headline: No. 1 Pistons eliminated by Cavaliers in Game 7 after leading 2-0
events.detail: CLE 125-94 at Detroit. Top East seed removed while NYK idle (rival-elimination shock for NYK).

events.headline: Jalen Williams exits WCF Game 2 with left hamstring strain
events.detail: Missed Games 3-5, played 10 min in Game 6, out for Game 7.

events.headline: Knicks sweep Cavaliers to reach first NBA Finals since 1999
events.detail: NYK 130-93 in Game 4 at Cleveland (Memorial Day).

events.headline: Thunder rule out Jalen Williams and Ajay Mitchell for WCF Game 7
events.detail: Announced the night before Game 7 (time = NBA.com article timestamp). Clean rival-injury news shock for SAS (and NYK's prospective opponent).

events.headline: Spurs beat defending-champion Thunder 111-103 in Game 7 at OKC
events.detail: First Finals berth since 2014; guarantees an 8th straight different champion.

events.headline: Finals Game 1: Knicks win 105-95 in San Antonio
events.detail: Knicks' 12th straight playoff win.

events.headline: Finals Game 2: Knicks win 105-104; lead 2-0
events.detail: Wembanyama missed at the end.

events.headline: Finals Game 3: Spurs win 115-111 at MSG
events.detail: Ended Knicks' 13-game playoff win streak; President Trump attended (first sitting president at a Finals game).

events.headline: Finals Game 4: Knicks overcome 29-point deficit, win 107-106 on Anunoby tip-in (1.2s)
events.detail: Largest comeback in NBA Finals history; NYK lead 3-1.

events.headline: Knicks win 2026 NBA championship, beat Spurs 94-90 in Game 5 (series 4-1)
events.detail: First title since 1973; Brunson Finals MVP (45 pts in clincher, 32.6 ppg in series). Game in San Antonio.

events.headline: Knicks championship parade up Broadway's Canyon of Heroes; Key to the City ceremony
events.detail: Battery Park to City Hall, 10 a.m. ET Thursday June 18, 2026.

events.headline: Bucks agree to trade Giannis Antetokounmpo to Heat
events.detail: Post-Finals move affecting 2026-27 odds (time = ESPN story timestamp). MIL get Herro, Ware, Jaquez, Jakucionis, three 1sts.
